claim: In the matching retail DLL, static DLCChecker.IsOwner (0x06001033) is a one-DLCEnum-parameter Boolean method with exact signature blob 0001021185c8 and an exact 39-byte code body. Before its protected region it calls DLCChecker.GetDLCID(dlcNum) (0x06001036), stores the returned DLCIDEnum, and constructs a Steamworks.AppId_t local through memberref 0x0A0006C4. Its single small exception clause protects IL+0x000F through IL+0x001C inclusive: inside that region it calls Steamworks.SteamApps.BIsSubscribedApp through memberref 0x0A0006C5, stores the Boolean result, and leaves to the shared return. The handler begins at IL+0x001D, has catch type token 0x010000C2 resolving to System.Object, pops the caught object, stores false, and leaves to the same return at IL+0x0025. FACT-0119 pins the already-canonical caller at SaveData.IsDLCInstalled IL+0x0001.
